Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear list. We can provide everything you asked for; I wanted to surface a couple of operational notes and a proposed plan so your committee can see mitigations if any control gaps are flagged.

Quick answers up front:
- Subprocessors: attaching the latest export (subprocessors_current.csv).
- Routing: by default our hosted control plane routes to nearest capacity; we have EU/UK pinned options for enterprise customers that prevent cross-border token-level processing. We can commit to EU-only processing for Rowland via a config flag and a TIA entry.
- TIAs: we will produce a DTIA/TIA table that maps services (KV cache, telemetry, model hosting) to regions and vendor endpoints.

Proposed deliverables and dates:
1) Today (12 Apr): subprocessors CSV + one-page quick summary
2) Tue (16 Apr): SCC matrix + TIA draft in Drive (link below)
3) Fri (20 Apr): Final DPA with UK IDTA addendum for signature (DocuSign link)

If the committee wants a fallback (rollback) capability, we recommend the following for the first 30 days after go-live:
- Enable EU-only region pinning (no cross-border processing)
- Enable conservative KV cache expiry for PII-heavy routes (48hr)
- Keep a read-only export snapshot pipeline for audits (48h retention)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3RowlandDPA
Attachments: sccs-uk-idta-matrix.xlsx, subprocessors_current.csv

Logan / Sophie — adding a few technical clarifications from infra/legal: we need to be explicit in the DTIA about the exact endpoints used for model inference, KV caching, and telemetry. Rowland's ask about Azure UK is straightforward if you will be pinned to UK/EU capacity.

Important points for the committee:
- SCCs: we provide the standard EU SCCs and the UK IDTA addendum. The matrix (attached) shows which clauses map to which technical controls.
- TIA specifics: for UK IDTA we must list the region + service + hostname pattern (e.g., *.uksouth.azure.redwood.io). We will generate the full DTIA table with those hostname patterns.
- Rollback plan (if routing exception is required): we can toggle the EU-only flag within a 15-minute window; however, you should be aware that model version pinning and warmed KV caches may take ~30–90 minutes to stabilize. We recommend a stated SLA in the MMP for rollback windows.

I have updated the Drive doc with the hostname patterns and a short-runbook for rollback operations. Please review sections 2.1 (hostname mapping) and 4.2 (rollback runbook).

Best,
